THE ACCESS TO HEALTH RECORDS AND REPORTS ACT 1993
THE ACCESS TO HEALTH RECORDS AND REPORTS ACT 1993
(APPOINTED DAY) ORDER 1994
In exercise of the powers conferred on the Department of Health
and Social Security by section 11(2) of the Access to Health
Records and Reports Act 1993(a), and of all other enabling
powers, the following Order is hereby made:-
tit
Citation
1. This Order may be cited as the Access to Health Records
and Reports Act 1993 (Appointed Day) Order 1994.
Commencement of the Act
2. The Access to Health Records and Reports Act 1993 shall
come into operation on the 1st July, 1994.
)(cid:9) MADE this(cid:9) 10th(cid:9) day of May 9'4
Minister for alth and Social Security
(a) 1993 c.
EXPLANATORY NOTE
(This note is not part of the Order)
This Order brings the Access to Health Records and Reports Act
1993 into force on the 1st July, 1994.
